title: E2E Triage Agent Result
description: Structured output from the e2e-triage agent. Each entry is one root CAUSE (which may affect one or several workspaces); the agent groups and authors the issue body itself. The merge script only collects entries.

target_branch.description: Branch the nightly ran against (e.g., main, release-1.10).

issues.description: One entry per distinct root cause. A cause affecting several workspaces is a single entry (umbrella) — the agent authors one deduplicated body.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of all classifications (log/context only).

affected_workspaces.description: Workspace name(s) this cause affects. One = single-workspace issue; several = umbrella. Used for tracking lines and the summary.

fix_category.description: Classification for this cause (one category per cause).

tests.description: Failed tests across all affected workspaces for this cause.

root_cause.description: The shared failure mechanism for this cause. Shown in the maintainer summary.

root_cause_slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this cause (e.g., oci-resolution, route-wait). Grouping hint and cross-run dedup anchor — keep it stable per cause across nights; split it when causes genuinely differ.

workspace.description: Workspace the test belongs to. Optional for single-workspace causes; set it on umbrella entries so tests can be attributed.

action.description: Whether to create a new issue, comment on an existing one, or skip.

number.description: Existing issue number (required for comment action).

body.description: Fully authored issue or comment body. For umbrellas the agent writes the shared root cause and remediation ONCE, then a failed-tests table per affected workspace — no repetition.

cycle_ready_to_code.description: When true, post-script removes then re-adds ready-to-code to force a new labeled event (used when issue exists but PR was closed).
